pages.text: The text marker looks like a yellow feather. Left-click a line to mark it, left-click it again to remove the mark. Marked lines get a yellow overlay.

Right-click another line of the same sheet to mark everything from your last left-clicked line to this one. If the last left click removed a mark, the right click removes the marks instead.$(br2)Each right click is remembered too, so you can grow a selection step by step.
Recipe: a feather and yellow dye, in any shape.
